findings.summary: _Summary reimplements a bespoke metric row (spaceAround Row of _metric columns) instead of using the shared MetricGrid/MetricCard.
findings.fix: Replace the custom Card+Row with MetricGrid(cards: [('الدورات', '${items.length}', Icons.school_rounded), ('مكتملة', '$completed', Icons.verified_rounded), ('إلزامية متبقية', '$mandatory', Icons.priority_high_rounded)]) so the summary matches other pages' metric styling.

findings.summary: Course status is rendered as inline plain text via _status() instead of the shared MobileStatusPill used across other pages.
findings.fix: Show the status with MobileStatusPill; since learning statuses (completed/in_progress/failed/expired/enrolled) are not yet in the pill's palette, extend MobileStatusPill's switch to cover them (reuse the shared green/red/purple/grey colors) and render the pill in the card header Row instead of the trailing text.

findings.summary: Error state is a bare centered Text with no icon/brand mark and no retry affordance.
findings.fix: Wrap the error in a Column with an error icon (Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error)) plus a FilledButton/TextButton that calls ref.invalidate(myLearningCatalogProvider) to retry, matching the pull-to-refresh action.

findings.summary: Empty state is a plain Card with only text — no illustrative icon or BrandLogoMark, inconsistent with richer empty headers.
findings.fix: Add a leading Icon (e.g. Icons.school_outlined) or BrandLogoMark above the 'لا توجد دورات مسجلة حاليًا.' text and use onSurfaceVariant color for a friendlier, on-brand empty state.

findings.summary: _metric hardcodes TextStyle(fontSize/fontWeight) instead of reading from Theme.textTheme, so it ignores the Cairo type scale.
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) for the value and labelMedium/bodySmall (onSurfaceVariant) for the label instead of raw fontSize values (superseded if you adopt MetricGrid).

findings.summary: Card title uses a hardcoded TextStyle(fontSize:17, weight:w900) rather than the theme titleMedium/titleLarge scale.
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) for the course title so sizing follows the design system's type scale.

findings.summary: LinearProgressIndicator uses default square ends; other progress visuals in the design system use rounded corners for consistency.
findings.fix: Add borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99) (and minHeight ~8) to the LinearProgressIndicator to match the app's rounded chip/pill language.

findings.summary: The category/duration/mode meta line sits directly under the title with no vertical gap and no muted color, reducing hierarchy.
findings.fix: Add a SizedBox(height: 4) before the meta Text and style it with Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant) to visually separate it from the title.
